caption: Too many AI moves chase perfection while we still waste hours on follow-ups and edits. This carousel shows a practical five-step prompt flow for repetitive admin tasks, from diagnosing time sinks to refining a reusable workflow. Copy the prompts, test them on one task, and measure time saved. Which admin task will you automate first? #AI #Productivity #Automation #Founders

slides.title: AI emails aren't finished
slides.body: Automate isn't magic; many chase speed and produce messy drafts. Here is a better five-prompt flow to fix admin tasks.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose time sinks
slides.body: List top 5 admin tasks weekly; give hours and root causes; Output: bulleted diagnostic with times.

slides.title: 2. Improve with templates
slides.body: Draft templates for common replies and schedules; output a finalized plain-text draft with placeholders {NAME}, {DATE}, {ACTION}.

slides.title: 3. Apply with automation
slides.body: Create a workflow to auto-fill templates from a task cue; output: a step-by-step automation plan; include trigger, data source, routing, and review.

slides.title: 4. Check output
slides.body: Run a quick QA rubric on a sample email batch; output: checklist evaluating tone, accuracy, completion, consistency.

slides.title: 5. Refine workflow
slides.body: Summarize learnings into a reusable prompt pack; output: final prompt bundle with guardrails and 2-min review checklist.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: A repeatable prompt pack cuts manual edits and keeps quality; start with a diagnostic prompt and build templates.
